_description: Privacy Policy for the Metin2 Okey mobile helper app. Data processing and usage information suitable for Google Play publishing.
intro: As the Metin2 Okey helper app, we care about our users' privacy. This policy explains the data usage approach of the mobile app and the web test page.
s1_p1: The app does not require creating an account or sharing mandatory personal data.
s1_p2: Data created during gameplay and kept on the device may include:
s1_li2: Current test game score and round data
s1_p3: By default, this data is used at the device/session level.
s2_p1: Anonymous technical data may be collected to improve stability and performance:
s2_li1: Device type and operating system version
s3_p1: The mobile version may use advertising and analytics services (e.g. Google AdMob).
s3_p2: The data processing practices of these services are governed by their own privacy policies.
s4_p1: We do not knowingly collect personal data from children under 13.
s5_p1: Reasonable technical measures are applied for data security. Local data may be deleted from the device when the app is uninstalled.
s6_p1: Privacy policy updates are published on this page along with the date they take effect.
